# Mane Man API: the ops console

mm-api on the ops console's host (docs/decisions/0026-hosts-and-surfaces.md), served at https://{host}/api/*, behind Cloudflare Access. Every call needs a valid Access token and is recorded in the audit log under its identity (docs/decisions/0031-access-and-audit.md). Every response carries an X-Request-Id header.

Errors carry a stable code and the request ID, never a stack trace or provider message:

```json
{
  "error": {
    "code": "not_found",
    "request_id": "…"
  }
}
```

}

  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/Health"

### POST /api/number-changes/{id}/decision

Confirm a number change, which then takes effect, or reject it

Request body:

```json
{
  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/NumberChangeDecision"
}
```

**200**: Decided

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "state": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "confirmed",
        "rejected"
      ]
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "state"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

**400**: invalid_request: a rejection needs a reason

```json
{
  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
}
```

**404**: not_found: no change waiting for ops by that ID

```json
{
  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
}
```

**409**: number_in_use: another person holds the new number

```json
{
  "$ref": "#/components/schemas/ErrorResponse"
}
```

## Schemas

### ErrorResponse

```json
{
  "type": "object",
  "properties": {
    "error": {
      "type": "object",
      "properties": {
        "code": {
          "type": "string",
          "enum": [
            "not_found",
            "invalid_request",
            "turnstile_failed",
            "rate_limited",
            "idempotency_in_progress",
            "idempotency_key_reused",
            "environment_mismatch",
            "unavailable",
            "internal_error",
            "busy",
            "photo_invalid_file",
            "upload_already_received",
            "upload_missing",
            "session_required",
            "job_not_claimable",
            "look_limit_reached",
            "unauthorized",
            "forbidden_origin",
            "access_required",
            "code_expired",
            "too_early",
            "number_in_use",
            "not_ready"
          ]
        },
        "request_id": {
          "type": "string"
        },
        "fields": {
          "type": "array",
          "items": {
            "type": "string"
          },
          "description": "invalid_request only: the fields that failed validation, never their values."
        }
      },
      "required": [
        "code",
        "request_id"
      ],
      "additionalProperties": false
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "error"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```

### Health

```json
{

      ]

    "version_id": {
      "type": "string",
      "description": "Cloudflare Worker version ID serving this request."
    },
    "version_tag": {
      "type": [
        "string",
        "null"
      ],
      "description": "Tag given at upload: the git commit SHA in remote environments."
    },
    "d1": {
      "type": "string",
      "enum": [
        "ok",
        "unmarked",
        "mismatch",
        "unreachable"
      ],
      "description": "ok: reachable and marked as this environment's database. unmarked: no identity row. mismatch: marked as another environment's database."
    }
  },
  "required": [
    "status",
    "environment",
    "version_id",
    "version_tag",
    "d1"
  ],
  "additionalProperties": false
}
```
